When I travel, I expect to meet people.

For the first time as well as ones I have known in the past.

I live in a small town.

Using the somewhat new airport, the chances are good you will meet someone that you know.

However, the city to the north has population nearly 10 times as this small enclave.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Took the requisite 1/4 mile (1735 ft or 530 meters) hike to the gate near the western end of Terminal A.

![](images/Screen%20Shot%202025-10-13%20at%2016.00.00.png)

Then comes a long a face I recognize.

Unsure where we worked together but I know we did.

As I reach out to him, I remember when and where.

2008 to 2010 at NOC.

He tells me nearly everyone that worked there are millionaires, but not multimillionaires.\^\[when I last worked there, the stock was \$41, on 13 Oct 2025, the stock is \$618.88\]

![](images/Screen%20Shot%202025-10-13%20at%2016.08.03.png)

We shared the notes on who we remember from those days. Jim Bloom, Mike Carter, and Neal Dahlen.

He said he retired at my current age.

Tried to commit him to a role, but he was being evasive.

He didn't want to be associate with the "smart" group, even though he has a PhD.

With that settled, asked him what takes him to the windy city.

He decided to go see his son play in a band.

A last minute decision that will set him back well over \$1000.

(Chicago Marathon was scheduled for this Sunday, which made hotel rooms both scarce and much higher than normal)

His son was playing at the Phyllis' Musical Inn on 1800 West Division Street.

Thought about joining him but we are here for a funeral and will have an early start.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Thought about retirement and the impromptu decision.

Would I book a last minute flight to see a family member perform.

He stopped working early and is enjoying life.

I was glad that he recognized me and we were able to visit about the NOC days.

I need to reevaluate my priorities.

Thanks Dan
